title: [IMP-17] Sequencer wire details are incomplete, and pin updates use the wrong type
description: Review finding IMP-17: Sequencer wire details are incomplete, and pin updates use the wrong type (lens IMP). Location: spec/14-jmap.md:156-165; spec/05-messaging.md:354, :362-364. Fix: As proposed. Confirmed: 05:354 gives type `urn:ietf:params:jmap:chat#Chat` and 05:364 says "MUST submit a pin update per §14.4.3", while 14:158 says the envelope "has `type` `urn:agora:type:JmapSet`". Also confirmed: 14:158 makes the raw MLSMessage the operation, which exposes the constant `group_id` to the sequencer (05:216 explains why that framing is otherwise sealed). Full text: notes/review/IMP-verified.md and notes/review/IMP.md.
